Added to the price

  • Cleaning, handover and bed linen: CZK 1,950 per stay.
  • Tourist tax set by the municipality: CZK 20 per person per night. It is included in the booking price according to the number of guests; any difference from the actual number is settled from the deposit.
  • Electricity by actual consumption: CZK 8/kWh, in winter up to about CZK 3,000 a day. Deducted from the deposit.
  • Refundable deposit: CZK 10,000 for 2 nights, by bank transfer no later than 3 days before arrival.
  • Cleaning after the wedding: the CZK 1,950 covers standard cleaning. Cleaning the terrace, common room and surroundings after the event is charged by the hours worked, CZK 350 per person per hour, or you can clean them yourselves.

Events with guests who do not stay overnight

  • A standard rental of the whole complex and the other packages are for accommodating the guests named in the booking, up to 37 people.
  • Birthday and stag or hen parties may also include guests who do not stay overnight. We agree their number in advance, write to us at info@panelcz.cz.
  • Weddings are booked as a wedding package on the Weddings page.
  • We can prepare a company party or other event with extra guests as a tailor-made package.
  • Guests who do not stay overnight park nearby along the road.
  • An event that is not announced in advance is charged as a package plus a contractual penalty of CZK 10,000, see the Terms.
Peace and location

Below Cornštejn, close to the water

Panelcz stands in the holiday settlement of Chmelnice on the shore of the Vranov reservoir, below the ruins of Cornštejn castle. Outside the summer season it is quiet here: no traffic, just forest, water and your group. A loud party disturbs no one, yet Znojmo is only 35 minutes away.

  • Sandy beach about 100 m from the complex
  • Cornštejn ruins and Bítov castle within sight
  • Fenced complex, parking for 10 cars right next to it
  • Close to Podyjí National Park
